integrity_notes: The general result is supported by an analytic rank-two determinant identity, a product heat-kernel ordering, and a discrete maximum principle; symbolic tests are supplementary. Independent review is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The graph is the unit-conductance Boolean hypercube and both positive gains are applied to distinct vertices.
The covariance/trace interpretation assumes isotropic independent input noise.
No claims for coordinate-anisotropic weights, heterogeneous noise, more than two leaders, or general graphs.
Bibliographic equivalence in incompletely indexed literature remains possible.
The exact finite tests corroborate but do not constitute the general proof.
title: Strict Hamming-distance ordering of unequal-gain two-leader coherence on Boolean cubes
